Normal.sae_definition: Nominal Operation - No Diagnostic Trouble Code Detected
Normal.standard_procedure: Vehicle operating within certified SAE J1979 parameters. No technician intervention required.

Battery/Electrical.sae_definition: System Voltage Low / Charging Circuit Failure
Battery/Electrical.standard_procedure: Execute SAE J2012 charging system test: test alternator output under load, measure battery cold cranking amps (CCA) and internal resistance, check drive belt tension, and inspect chassis ground loops.

Fuel System.sae_definition: Fuel Rail / System Pressure Too Low
Fuel System.standard_procedure: Execute SAE J2012 fuel delivery diagnostic: test low-pressure in-tank fuel pump delivery rate, inspect fuel filter for particulate clogging, verify high-pressure rail relief valve, and inspect injector spray patterns.

Engine Mechanical.standard_procedure: Execute SAE J2012 misfire diagnostic procedure: inspect ignition coil pack waveform, inspect spark plug electrode gap and carbon fouling, perform cylinder compression test, and check for intake manifold vacuum leaks.

Cooling System.standard_procedure: Execute SAE J2012 cooling diagnostic tree: inspect thermostat opening valve, verify radiator cooling fan relay activation, inspect water pump flow, and pressure-test cooling circuit for head gasket breach.
